title: Relative Clauses in Business
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Usar Relative Clauses (Who, Which, That, Whose) te permite unir ideas y hablar con mucha más fluidez y precisión.

parts.visual:
Usamos pronombres relativos para dar más información sobre una persona o cosa sin empezar una nueva oración. 
- WHO / THAT (Para personas). 
- WHICH / THAT (Para cosas o animales).
parts.audio: We use relative pronouns to give more information about a person or thing without starting a new sentence. We use WHO or THAT for people. We use WHICH or THAT for things.

parts.visual:
Ejemplos: 
The manager WHO hired me is from London (El gerente que me contrató es de Londres). 
The software WHICH we use is very expensive (El software que usamos es muy caro). 
- WHOSE (De quién / Cuyo - indica posesión). 
The company WHOSE CEO resigned is in trouble (La empresa cuyo CEO renunció está en problemas).
parts.audio: Examples. The manager who hired me is from London. The software which we use is very expensive. We use WHOSE to show possession. For example: The company whose CEO resigned is in trouble.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el pronombre relativo correcto (who, which, that, whose, where).

questions.question: The client ____ called yesterday wants a meeting. (Persona).
The report ____ I sent you has all the details. (Cosa).
This is the employee ____ sales figures are the highest. (Cuyas ventas / De quién).
questions.explanation: Whose = cuyo/cuya (indica que las ventas le pertenecen a ese empleado).

questions.question: The office ____ we work is very small. (Lugar).
questions.explanation: Where se usa para referirse a lugares (donde).

questions.question: I need to speak to the person ____ is in charge of HR. (Persona).
They bought a company ____ manufactures computer chips. (Cosa/Entidad).
questions.explanation: That se puede usar para cosas (igual que which).

questions.question: Do you know the woman ____ car is parked outside? (Cuyo auto).
2020 was the year ____ we launched our best product. (Tiempo).
questions.explanation: When se usa para referencias de tiempo.

questions.question: He is the manager ____ I told you about. (Persona).
questions.explanation: Who (a veces whom si es muy formal y es objeto).

questions.question: The contract ____ we signed last week is already active. (Cosa).
I don't like meetings ____ last more than an hour. (Cosa/Evento).
We are looking for a candidate ____ English is perfect. (Cuyo inglés).
This is the conference room ____ we hold all our important meetings. (Lugar).
The candidate ____ we interviewed yesterday was excellent. (Persona).
questions.explanation: Who (o whom en casos muy formales).

questions.question: Can you send me the email ____ has the attachment? (Cosa).
My boss, ____ is 50 years old, is retiring next year. (Persona - cláusula no restrictiva).
questions.explanation: En cláusulas entre comas (no restrictivas) siempre usamos 'who' para personas, no 'that'.

questions.question: Our headquarters, ____ are located in New York, will be renovated. (Cosa - cláusula no restrictiva).
questions.explanation: En cláusulas entre comas usamos 'which' para cosas, nunca 'that'.

questions.question: Let's hire the freelancer ____ portfolio is the most creative. (Cuyo portafolio).
I remember the day ____ I started working here. (Tiempo).
The printer ____ is broken needs to be replaced. (Cosa).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el pronombre relativo correcto (who, which, whose, where, when).

questions.question: The man ____ called you is here. (Persona)
The file ____ I attached is a PDF. (Cosa)
The company ____ CEO resigned. (Cuyo)
The city ____ we met. (Lugar/Donde)
The day ____ we launched the app. (Tiempo/Cuando)
The woman ____ car is blue. (Cuyo)
The problem ____ we have is complex. (Cosa - empieza con W)
The person ____ did this is fired. (Persona)
The room ____ we had the meeting is cold. (Lugar)
The employee ____ laptop was stolen. (Cuyo)
